annotatedSteps.description: Balanced chemical equation for reaction of Zn with dilute HCl
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: × Incorrect formula for zinc chloride (ZnCl2) and the equation is unbalanced.

annotatedSteps.description: Confirmatory test for the evolved hydrogen gas
annotatedSteps.studentWork: Test: bring a burning splinter near the gas, it burns with a pop sound. So gas is hydrogen.
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ✓ Correct test and observation for hydrogen gas.

teacherNote: You identified the correct test and characteristic pop sound for hydrogen gas. Remember that zinc forms divalent Zn2+ ions, giving zinc chloride the formula ZnCl2, which requires 2HCl to balance the equation.

rubric.point: Writing the correct chemical formula of reactants and products (Zn, HCl, ZnCl2, H2)
Balancing the chemical equation (Zn + 2HCl -> ZnCl2 + H2)
Test for hydrogen gas (bringing a burning splinter near the gas burns with a pop sound)
